The weighted cloud reliability calculator passed all tests with a perfect reward score, validating the core logic and integration.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.82 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest successfully validated the implementation in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. Note that LiteLLM issued warnings regarding missing 'botocore' modules for Bedrock and SageMaker runtimes, which did not impact the local calculation logic but should be addressed if cloud-based model streaming is required.
